Hero.Eyebrow: Leading Soybean Processing Company - Kaduna, Nigeria
Hero.Heading: Industrial soybean processing for bulk supply nationwide.
Hero.Description: Mamia Seeds Oil Limited is an established Nigerian agricultural manufacturing company that processes soybeans into premium soybean meal, refined soya cooking oil, and industrial supply outputs for business customers nationwide.

History.Intro: Mamia Seeds Oil Limited was established on 16 July 2005 and has grown into a disciplined soybean processing operation serving industrial and commercial buyers.
Paragraphs: From its production base at Kutungare Village, Airport Road, Makarfi, the company operates with a clear focus on bulk supply, industrial manufacturing discipline, and dependable output.
Its flagship commercial line is premium soybean meal for feed-industry customers, supported by refined soya cooking oil and other soybean-derived supply opportunities.
